concerns.text: FR-003 and FR-006 require filtering for methodological shifts and >20% sample size changes. Task T014 implements this logic but is marked unchecked [ ]. Without this task, the pipeline cannot satisfy the exclusion requirements, leading to invalid analysis.

FR-004 mandates comparing p-curve *results* (power/p-hacking prevalence) rather than raw density ratios. Tasks T022b and T022c explicitly implement this comparison but are marked unchecked [ ]. The spec requires this specific output, which is currently missing from the active plan.

FR-002 requires applying censored data methods (Tobit regression) for paired effect-size analysis. Task T023b (implementing the Tobit model application) is marked unchecked [ ]. T004 only defines the helper; without T023b, the censored data requirement is unimplemented.

SC-002 requires validating the observed density ratio against a null distribution. Tasks T026a (generate null distribution) and T026 (validate against null) are both marked unchecked [ ]. This leaves the primary success criterion for distributional shift unimplemented.

SC-004 requires verifying bias direction consistency across thresholds. Tasks T028 (sweep thresholds) and T031 (verify consistency) are marked unchecked [ ]. The robustness requirement cannot be met without these active tasks.

FR-002 requires excluding inequality p-values from p-curve analysis. While T021a adds a filter, the upstream task T016 (interval-censoring logic to tag data) is marked unchecked [ ]. This creates a dependency gap where the filter may lack properly structured input data.

US-2 Acceptance Scenario 3 requires outputting results stratified by field. Task T024 (stratification logic) is marked unchecked [ ]. The analysis will fail to provide domain-specific bias detection as required.

FR-002 requires logging extraction failures. Task T014 mentions logging exclusion reasons but is unchecked. Additionally, no specific task is marked to handle the 'unsupported types MUST be logged as extraction failures' clause of FR-002 explicitly if T014 is not executed.

SC-001 (target ≥60% match rate) and the Assumption of a 1000-paper initial query have no corresponding active task to perform the initial query size calculation or the match-rate verification step. T013 fetches data but does not explicitly validate the match rate against the target.
FR-004 requires excluding pairs where p-values are identical (within rounding error). No active task explicitly implements this specific exclusion logic in the analysis phase (T023/T023b).
